plugin.name: MONETA FX · Forex Paper-Trading Room
plugin.description: A full port of the MONETA FX fictional forex room: shared invented market, market/limit/stop orders, stop-loss and take-profit, margin and liquidation, overnight swaps, candlestick charts and account analytics.
panel.subtitle: Shared fictional market · simulated funds · all quotes and fills are game data

panel.auth.intro: Enter the same fictional market; the developer drives the market while each account keeps its own funds.
panel.auth.registerIntro: Start with 100,000 USD of simulated funds. Player accounts can trade, review and learn.
panel.auth.footnote: Offline practice needs no login; shared accounts are saved by the server.
